shortDescription: Local user operations for PowerStore Storage System

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: is_locked
options.description: Whether the user account is locked or not. Defaults to C(false) at creation time.

options.name: new_password
options.description: New password for the existing local user account.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: role_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the role to which the local user account will be mapped. It is mutually exclusive with I(role_name).

options.name: role_name
options.description: The name of the role to which the local user account will be mapped. It is mutually exclusive with I(role_id).

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the local user should exist or not.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: user_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the local user account. Mutually exclusive with I(user_name).

options.name: user_name
options.description: Name of the local user account. Mutually exclusive with I(user_id). Mandatory only for create operation.

options.name: user_password
options.description: Password for the new local user account to be created. Mandatory only for create operation.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
